runningAgentBridgeProcesses.Name: powershell.exe
runningAgentBridgeProcesses.CommandLine:
"C:\WINDOWS\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -Command "[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8;
@'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$reportDir = Join-Path (Get-Location) (\"reports/fix-increment3-$timestamp\")
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $reportDir -Force | Out-Null

$runKey = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'
$entryName = 'AgentBridgePC'

$regBackupPath = Join-Path $reportDir 'hkcu-run-before.reg'
& reg.exe export \"HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\" \"$regBackupPath\" /y | Out-Null

$beforeValue = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $runKey -Name $entryName -ErrorAction Stop).$entryName
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reportDir 'agentbridgepc-command-before.txt') -Value $beforeValue -Encoding UTF8

$bytes = New-Object byte[] 32
[System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create().GetBytes($bytes)
$token = [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes).TrimEnd('=') -replace '\+', '-' -replace '/', '_'

$updatedValue = $beforeValue
if ($updatedValue -match '-BindHost\s+\"[^\"]*\"') {
  $updatedValue = [regex]::Replace($updatedValue, '-BindHost\s+\"[^\"]*\"', '-BindHost \"127.0.0.1\"')
} else {
  $updatedValue = \"$updatedValue -BindHost \\\"127.0.0.1\\\"\"
}
if ($updatedValue -match '-SharedToken\s+\"[^\"]*\"') {
  $escaped = [regex]::Escape($token)
  $updatedValue = [regex]::Replace($updatedValue, '-SharedToken\s+\"[^\"]*\"', ('-SharedToken \"' + $token + '\"'))
} else {
  $updatedValue = \"$updatedValue -SharedToken \\\"$token\\\"\"
}

Set-ItemProperty -Path $runKey -Name $entryName -Value $updatedValue -Type String

$afterValue = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $runKey -Name $entryName -ErrorAction Stop).$entryName

$tokenHash = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($token))
$tokenHashHex = -join ($tokenHash | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('x2') })

$afterRedacted = [regex]::Replace($afterValue, '(-SharedToken\s+\")[^\"]*(\")', '$1<redacted>$2')
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reportDir 'agentbridgepc-command-after-redacted.txt') -Value $afterRedacted -Encoding UTF8

$hasLoopback = $afterValue -match '-BindHost\s+\"127\.0\.0\.1\"'
$hasNonPlaceholderToken = ($afterValue -match '-SharedToken\s+\"[^\"]+\"') -and ($afterValue -notmatch '-SharedToken\s+\"change_me\"')

$runningBridge = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='powershell.exe'\" | Where-Object {
  ($_.CommandLine -like '*Start-AgentBridge-PC.ps1*') -or ($_.CommandLine -like '*agent-bridge*')
} | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine

$restoreScript = @\"
`$before = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath `\"$($reportDir -replace '\\','\\')\\agentbridgepc-command-before.txt`\"
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'AgentBridgePC' -Value `$before -Type String
\"@
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reportDir 'restore-run-agentbridgepc.ps1') -Value $restoreScript -Encoding UTF8

$summary = [pscustomobject]@{
  date = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
  mode = 'startup token hardening without restart'
  runKey = $runKey
  entryName = $entryName
  changed = ($beforeValue -ne $afterValue)
  checks = [pscustomobject]@{
    bindHostLoopback = $hasLoopback
    sharedTokenPresent = ($afterValue -match '-SharedToken\s+\"[^\"]+\"')
    sharedTokenPlaceholderRemoved = $hasNonPlaceholderToken
  }
  token = [pscustomobject]@{
    length = $token.Length
    sha256 = $tokenHashHex
  }
  runningAgentBridgeProcessCount = @($runningBridge).Count
  runningAgentBridgeProcesses = @($runningBridge)
  rollback = [pscustomobject]@{
    runKeyBackup = $regBackupPath
    restoreScript = (Join-Path $reportDir 'restore-run-agentbridgepc.ps1')
  }
}
$summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reportDir 'summary.json') -Encoding UTF8

$md = @(
  '# Increment 3 Summary (Applied)'
  ''
  ('Date: ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd'))
  'Mode: startup token hardening without restart'
  ''
  '## Change applied'
  '- Backed up `HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run` to `hkcu-run-before.reg`.'
  '- Updated `AgentBridgePC` startup command in-place:'
  '  - `-BindHost \"0.0.0.0\"` -> `-BindHost \"127.0.0.1\"`'
  '  - `-SharedToken \"change_me\"` -> strong random token (redacted in artifacts)'
  '- No service/process restart was executed.'
  ''
  '## Validation'
  ('- Bind host hardened to loopback: ' + $hasLoopback)
  ('- Placeholder token removed: ' + $hasNonPlaceholderToken)
  ('- Running AgentBridge-like process count (observed, unchanged by this step): ' + @($runningBridge).Count)
  ''
  '## Artifacts'
  '- `agentbridgepc-command-before.txt`'
  '- `agentbridgepc-command-after-redacted.txt`'
  '- `summary.json`'
  '- `restore-run-agentbridgepc.ps1`'
  ''
  '## Rollback'
  '```powershell'
  'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\restore-run-agentbridgepc.ps1'
  '```'
)
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reportDir 'INCREMENT3_SUMMARY.md') -Value $md -Encoding UTF8

Write-Output (\"REPORT_DIR=\" + $reportDir)
Write-Output (\"CHANGED=\" + ($beforeValue -ne $afterValue))
Write-Output (\"BIND_HOST_LOOPBACK=\" + $hasLoopback)
Write-Output (\"PLACEHOLDER_REMOVED=\" + $hasNonPlaceholderToken)
Write-Output (\"RUNNING_PROCESS_COUNT=\" + @($runningBridge).Count)
'@ | powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -"
